gates.name: Discovery
gates.description: Inspect project environment, repository state, existing instructions, relevant tools, and baseline risks.
exitCriteria: Working tree status verified (clean or documented uncommitted changes)
Project boundaries and scope established
Project contract approved

gates.name: Requirements Approval
gates.description: Confirm scope, constraints, objectives, and acceptance criteria.
exitCriteria: Functional and non-functional requirements documented
Acceptance criteria defined with testable scenarios
Requirements contract signed off

gates.name: Design Approval
gates.description: For visual products, approve visual direction, tokens, and specifications before interface implementation.
exitCriteria: Design tokens defined or formal exemption recorded with justification
Responsive breakpoints and component states specified
Design contract signed off or exempted

gates.name: Architecture & Plan Approval
gates.description: Approve material technical decisions, interfaces, dependencies, phases, and verification plans.
entryCriteria: Gate G2 approved or formally exempted
exitCriteria: System components, dependencies, and boundaries defined
Implementation WBS and task dependency graph approved
Security model and ADRs documented

gates.name: Implementation Verification
gates.description: Inspect actual changes and evaluate acceptance criteria using applicable checks.
exitCriteria: All assigned tasks implemented within bounded files
Applicable test suites and linters executed with passing evidence
No unapproved scope expansion or anti-slop violations

gates.name: Independent Review
gates.description: Review correctness, regressions, maintainability, security, scope compliance, and quality evidence.
entryCriteria: Gate G4 completed with test evidence
exitCriteria: Independent reviewer verifies code diff against requirements
Quality profile standards evaluated and passed
No unresolved blocking defects

gates.name: Release or Handoff
gates.description: Record verified deliverables, outstanding defects, exceptions, limitations, deferred work, and next steps.
exitCriteria: Release contract signed off
Git-aware memory state synchronized with repository
Handoff checklist complete
